The renderer foundation of the NE.Standard UI web platform — the renderer base and the shared style, text and input helpers a package's own web renderer builds on — without the built-in renderers themselves.

The bottom layer of the NE.Standard UI framework: the enums, attributes and constants everything above it is written in — the styling, binding, validation and access vocabulary, and the names of events, regions, templates and glyphs. No dependencies.
The hosting and runtime contracts of the NE.Standard UI framework: IUIHost, IUIRuntime, IUIUpdateSink, sessions, services and the file-transfer surface a platform implements.
Presets over the NE.Standard UI components: shorthands for the component arrangements an application writes again and again: text, pages, layouts, buttons, forms and details.
What an application author writes against in the NE.Standard UI framework: the component, view and controller base contracts.
The authoring foundation of the NE.Standard UI framework — the component bases a package's own component derives from and the template bindings — without the built-in components themselves.

The engine of the NE.Standard UI framework: it compiles a view and a controller into an immutable indexed description once, then keeps the rendered surface and the controller's object graph in sync both ways. Hosting, routing, sessions and scheduling included.
The compiler's output in the NE.Standard UI framework: CompiledView, the indexes a renderer and a runtime address it through, and the resolution over them.
The HTML renderers for the built-in NE.Standard UI components, and the registry a host resolves them through; their bases are NE.Standard.UI.Web.Renderers.Foundation.

The binding and addressing model of the NE.Standard UI framework: RecursiveObservable, the items and interaction contracts, the colour and theme roles, and the client-effect vocabulary a command and an interaction both run.
The render contracts of the NE.Standard UI web platform: what a component renderer is asked for, and what an add-on package implements to render one of its own.

The built-in components of the NE.Standard UI framework — layouts, contents, actions, navigation, inputs, indicators, items and overlays — and the default templates a host renders them through; their bases are NE.Standard.UI.Components.Foundation.

The ASP.NET Core host of the NE.Standard UI framework: the shell, the SignalR live channel, file transfer over HTTP, and the TypeScript client, which ships embedded in the assembly — there is no separate front-end deploy step.

A code editor component for the NE.Standard UI framework: a monospaced field with syntax highlighting for JSON, CSS and LESS, JavaScript and TypeScript, HTML, C#, Python, Bash and Markdown, line numbers, and find and replace; and a Markdown display that shows a document as formatted text. The web rendering of NE.Standard.UI.CodeInput: the renderers, the highlighting, line numbers and find-and-replace engine, and the Markdown renderer the package embeds as its own script and stylesheet. Register it with services.AddCodeInput().

Every Material Symbols name, as constants an NE.Standard UI component can be given. Platform-independent - the rendering lives in the platform's own icon package, which serves only the glyphs an application registers. MIT, unlike the framework it plugs into.

Material Symbols Rounded for the NE.Standard UI web platform. One 386 KB variable font ships embedded — every glyph, with FILL and the optical size still axes — and the stylesheet is built at startup from the glyphs the application registers. MIT, unlike the framework it plugs into; the font itself…

Graphs for the NE.Standard UI framework, three components on one canvas (pan, zoom, groups, a document the viewer edits and saves): NodesComponent, a node editor whose kinds are the application's own attributed classes, with a runner; LayeredGraphComponent, a layered graph over the application's no…

The web rendering of NE.Standard.UI.Graph: the renderers of the node editor, the layered graph and the production graph, and the canvas engine they share — pan, zoom, groups, the layered layout, the planner's solver and the document's undo history — embedded as the package's own script and styleshe…

Picture node kinds for the NE.Standard UI node canvas, worked on the server with SkiaSharp: load and save a file, size, resize, crop, rotate, flip, greyscale, blur and convert, each writing a new picture to an image store the application chooses; an in-memory store that serves them comes with it.

A calculator's node kinds for the NE.Standard UI node canvas: arithmetic, rounding, sums, clamps, the least or most of several, comparisons and a result to read after a run, over the common kinds' numbers. Add them to a catalogue beside an application's own kinds.

The web rendering of NE.Standard.UI.DataGrid: the grid renderer over the framework's table renderer, the typed cell, and the sorting, filtering and editing engines the package embeds as its own script and stylesheet. Register it with services.AddDataGrid().

A data grid component for the NE.Standard UI framework: the table with everything the built-in one leaves to an add-on — sorting by header, typed and formatted columns, editing in place, filters and a search box, paging, a footer of totals, pinned and responsive columns with a chooser, a detail row…
